headline: Linn Mercy Quiets As Godcrofts Turns Fully Colonial
war_summary: Since the last edition the wires have quieted at Linn Mercy and Marban Hollow, both recording no ownership changes in the last two hours after 33 and 37 flips in the day around Lathair, Outwich Ranch, Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, while Godcrofts eases to four changes in two hours against 46 in the day around Isawa, Fleecewatch and Ursa Base and now stands listed at nine Colonial posts with none neutral or Warden-held. Palantine Berm counts two changes in two hours against 44 in the day around Vendett and Windburn Landing, now listed at four Warden to three Colonial, and Farranac Coast stirs anew with two changes in two hours among nine in the day at Transient Valley. Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse show no change in two hours despite 16, 19 and 34 in the day, Nevish Line and Kuura Strand add late single-post activity, and Callahan's Passage and Deadlands report heavy but unflipped casualty lists.
